readme.summary: Clear and well-structured documentation with good basic examples, but lacks troubleshooting guidance and detailed configuration options.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section despite complex dependencies and compilation requirements that could easily go wrong

common_complaints: Performance issues with regex operations causing 40+ second processing times
Missing DWARF 5 support (debug_loclists) breaking with modern gcc versions
Cross-compilation failures with shared object file loading
Incorrect symbol path assembly for debug information
Duplicate function name handling when multiple files contain same function
Lack of documentation for output format and tool behavior
praise_themes: Appreciation for open-sourcing the tool and related toolset
Recognition of usefulness for ABI compliance checking
sentiment.summary: Community health is poor with stagnant maintenance: 5 open issues spanning 4+ years, no 1.3 release published despite being listed in README, zero maintainer engagement visible, and critical regressions from modern toolchains (gcc 11+ DWARF 5, dwz compression) left unaddressed.

communication.summary: Maintainer responses are clear, helpful, and patient. Technical depth is strong, and the communication style is welcoming.
